_comment: Example from the Tesla Roadster explainer: per frame, [clause index, what appears] pairs. Clause indexes point into audio_meta.json voices[].words.

1.note: keep the full-screen statement-per-beat build onto a payoff; the payoff is a question mark instead of a spring-pop logo
1.focal: 三個大字事實（倒掛／飛起來／0.81 秒）與最後的問號
1.roles: graph-paper grid + top/bottom hairlines = background · fact words = foreground subject · 「0→60 mph ≈ 97 km/h · Tesla 宣稱」 chrome = supporting
1.sfx: soft whoosh on each fact, low thud on the question mark
scenes: Centered. Only the grid and hairlines; 「倒掛」 enters as one display-hero word, upside down, and flips 180° to upright on `move` ease as the VO says 倒掛 — the flip IS the idea.
Hard-cut word swap: 「倒掛」 is replaced in place by 「飛起來」, which rises ~6% of frame height and settles (enter ease).
Swap again: a vbig-numeral 「0」 appears and counts up through 「0.81 秒」 across the 不到一秒 / 衝到時速九十七公里 clauses; the small chrome tag 「0→60 mph ≈ 97 km/h · Tesla 宣稱」 types in under it.
The three facts collapse into a single left-aligned stack (倒掛 / 飛起來 / 0.81 秒, headline size) while a large 「？」 in inverted cobalt block lands right of center on the 這是一台車 cue; hold still to the end.

2.note: frame-then-fill: the car silhouette draws on, then three numbered slots fill one by one
2.roles: grid = background · car line art = foreground subject (≈55% width, centered, upper half) · three numbered slots = supporting (row beneath the car) · source chrome = supporting
2.sfx: pen-scratch tick as the silhouette draws, three soft ticks for the slots
scenes: The car silhouette self-draws (SVG path draw, wheels last) across the 特斯拉…Roadster clause; DM Mono chrome 「2026/10/15 發表 · 示意圖」 appears top-left after the draw completes.
Under the car three empty square slots appear with numerals ①②③ and the labels 倒掛／滯空／加速 (staggered ~0.2 s) as the VO says 三個神奇配備.

On 國中理化學過的原理 each slot gains its principle in Newsreader/Noto Serif: 壓力差 → 作用力與反作用力 → 摩擦力, staggered; slot ① inverts briefly to cobalt as a pointer to the next chapter. Bottom-left chrome 「性能數字皆為 Tesla 發表會宣稱」. Hold.

3.note: cutaway diagram built layer by layer
3.focal: 車子剖面圖：車底四具風扇、裙邊、低壓區
3.roles: grid = background · car cutaway on a road line = foreground subject (≈60% width, asymmetric 60/40 left) · pressure arrows + 「低壓」「大氣壓」 labels = supporting (right rail labels)
3.sfx: fan spin-up whir under the fan clause, a soft air-seal 'thunk' on the skirts
scenes: Chapter card: 「① 倒掛」 slams in as an inverted cobalt block top-left (display-chapter), the car silhouette from frame 2 is already on the road line.
The car turns into a cutaway: the underbody line draws, then four small round fan rotors pop in along the floor (stagger ~0.09 s) and start spinning (live SVG, continuous).
Airflow: dotted cobalt lines stream from under the car out through the fans and away (dash-flow); the dots under the car thin out.
Two skirt plates slide down at the front and rear edges and seal the gap to the road; label 「裙邊」 ticks in.
The underbody region fills with sparse dots and the label 「低壓」 appears beneath the car.

Dense arrows from above and the sides push toward the car body (draw-on, stagger), label 「大氣壓」 on the right rail; the whole car settles 4px down onto the road on `land` ease. Hold with only fans + airflow alive.

4.note: worked example: the same cutaway flips upside down while a formula assembles term by term
4.focal: 倒掛的車 + 逐行出現的估算算式
4.roles: grid = background · inverted car on a ceiling track = foreground subject (left 55%) · formula column = foreground secondary (right 40%) · 「估算」 tag = supporting
4.sfx: slow rotation whoosh as the stage flips, typewriter ticks for each formula line
scenes: The whole frame-3 stage (car + road line) rotates 180° on `move` ease so the road becomes a ceiling track and the car hangs upside down; fans keep spinning. A big 「？」 sits beside it on 要多大的吸力.
Formula column, line 1 assembles: 「1,700 kg → 重力 ≈ 16,700 N」 (numbers count up), DM Mono units.
Line 2: 「÷ 車底面積 4 m²」 and a dashed rectangle outlines the car floor area in the diagram.
Line 3 lands: 「= 壓力差 ≈ 4,200 Pa」, then the result line inverts into a cobalt block 「≈ 大氣壓的 4%」 with a pixel-stack bar showing 4 of 100 cells filled; tag 「估算」.
Hold the finished stage still ≥ 1 s (only fans alive) through 就能倒掛不掉下來.

5.note: action/reaction paired arrows on the cutaway
5.focal: 四角向下推進器噴氣 + 一對大小相等、方向相反的箭頭
5.roles: grid = background · car cutaway (thrusters visible at the four corners) = foreground subject (centered, ≈55%) · paired arrows + labels = foreground secondary · 「高壓空氣 ≈ 10,000 psi · 不燃燒」 chip = supporting
5.sfx: sharp compressed-air hiss on the jet, soft rising tone as the car lifts
scenes: Chapter card 「② 滯空」 slams in as an inverted cobalt block top-left; the car is back upright on the road line, thrusters drawn as small nozzles at the corners.
A chip 「SpaceX 冷氣推進器」 with sub-label 「高壓空氣 ≈ 10,000 psi · 不燃燒 · Tesla 宣稱」 types in at upper right; a thin leader line points to a nozzle.
The nozzles fire: short-dash cobalt jets burst downward from each corner (dash-flow, fast).
A thick down arrow labeled 「氣體 ↓ 作用力」 draws under the car.
A matching up arrow 「車子 ↑ 反作用力」 draws above the car at the same length, and the car lifts off the road line by ~8% of frame height on `enter` ease.
A caption block 「大小相等 · 方向相反」 inverts in cobalt between the arrows; hold with jets alive.

6.note: a resource bar drains while the hop resolves
6.focal: 氣瓶存量 pixel-stack 條從滿到空
6.roles: grid = background · airborne car = foreground subject (left 55%) · tank pixel-stack bar + 「幾秒」 timeline = foreground secondary (right rail) · 「跳一下 ≠ 飛行」 = payoff text
6.sfx: hiss that thins out as the tank drains, a soft landing thump
scenes: The car hangs in the air with jets firing; on the right a vertical pixel-stack tank bar 「氣瓶」 appears full (cells on).
Cells switch off top-down in quick steps across 全力噴只撐得了幾秒; a mono timeline under it is marked only 「0 s … 幾秒」.
Jets cut as the bar empties; the car drops back to the road line on `land` ease (one small settle) — 跳一下.
Small attitude arrows flick at the front and rear nozzles (one quick tilt-and-level) on 控制姿態.
Payoff text 「跳一下 ≠ 飛行」 (display-chapter, the 「≠」 in an inverted block) lands upper right; hold still.

7.note: keep numbers-as-hero with a bar that grows to land one hero metric; the surface is a horizontal g-scale of pixel-stack cells instead of a ring
7.focal: 水平加速度刻度尺（g）上的兩條 pixel-stack 長條
7.roles: grid = background · g-scale strip = foreground subject (full-width strip, centered vertically ≈ y 450) · formula 「摩擦力 = μ × 正向力」 = supporting (top-left) · value labels = supporting
7.sfx: tick per scale mark, a rising tone as the 3.4 g bar overshoots the first
scenes: Chapter card 「③ 加速」 slams in as an inverted cobalt block top-left.
The formula 「摩擦力 = μ × 正向力」 assembles term by term at top-left; a full-width scale strip draws with ticks 0 / 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 g (DM Mono).
Bar ① grows cell by cell to 1.5 g, labelled 「頂級跑車輪胎 ≈ 1.5 g → 0→100 約 1.9 秒」 with tag 「估算」; the 1.5 g value counts up.
Bar ② (inverted cobalt cells) grows past bar ① all the way to 3.4 g while 「0.81 秒 → 97 km/h · Tesla 宣稱」 types above it; the 3.4 g value counts up and lands as a vbig-numeral.
A bracket marks the gap between 1.5 g and 3.4 g with 「× 2.3」; hold still ≥ 1 s.

8.note: build-up on the same g-scale: two boosts stack onto the tire bar until they reach 3.4 g
8.focal: 同一條 g 刻度尺：輪胎長條 + 兩段補強
8.roles: grid = background · g-scale strip (same as frame 7) = foreground subject · the formula with 「正向力」 = foreground secondary (upper left) · small car icons for each boost = supporting
8.sfx: air-seal thunk on the suction boost, compressed-air burst on the thruster boost, a clean ding when the stack reaches 3.4 g
scenes: The frame-7 scale holds; bar ② fades to a dashed outline 「目標 3.4 g」 and a 「？」 sits at its end on 怎麼做到.
Callback to frame 3: a tiny cutaway car with downward pressure arrows appears above the strip, label 「吸地力」.
In the formula, 「正向力」 scales up and inverts to a cobalt block (emphasis by inversion).
Bar ① extends: a second segment of cells stacks onto the 1.5 g tire bar, labelled 「摩擦力變大」.
A thick forward arrow from a rear thruster icon pushes a third segment onto the bar, labelled 「推進器直接推 · 不經過輪胎」.
The stacked bar reaches the dashed 3.4 g target, the outline turns solid; brief hold.

9.note: one restrained reveal, then a still hold; content is the three principle slots from frame 2 plus one closing line
9.focal: 三個原理格子排成一列
9.roles: grid = background · three principle slots (triptych, upper half) = foreground subject · closing line = foreground secondary · source chrome = supporting
scenes: Triptych: slot 「壓力差」 appears (slide-up crossfade) in the left third.
Slot 「作用力與反作用力」 appears in the middle third.
Slot 「摩擦力」 appears in the right third.
The car silhouette from frame 2 draws on small beneath the slots.
Closing line 「神奇配備 = 你學過的物理」 lands centered below (display-chapter); chrome 「性能數字皆為 Tesla 2026/10/15 發表會宣稱 · 量產目標 2028 年」 bottom-left above the caption band. Hold still to the end.
